name: baccarat-evolution-half-width-full-length
label: Evolution — Half Width / Full Length
captureTarget: Betting buttons plus the result display and cards, without the chat panel.
ocrUse: Reads the hand result; keeps the prompt small so replies come back faster.
notes: The common case for a casino sitting in the right half of the screen. Evolution's card display sits higher; the result strip is usually narrower. Run calibration with your casino window open before enabling OCR; this region is a starting point, not a measurement.
